en: Color lithographic postcard with two vignette views labeled in German: one shows the medieval gate with four sharp spires (Catherine's Gate) and another view marked Waisenhausgasserthor, both from Kronstadt (Brașov). A floral motif decorates the front along with a handwritten German message. The address side reads "Levelező-lap" in Hungarian and bears postmarks from Nagy-Szeben, addressed to Frau Friederike Fitsch in Hermannstadt, Siebenbürgen.
